name: Touhou Jochuugeki
source:
Touhou parody game. Main character gets to train two heroines during working days to get his prize during weekends.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]

东方Project的戏仿作品。主人公在工作日训练两名女主角，并在周末获得自己的奖励。
